notes: CurbToken is src/CurbToken.sol: Curb (CURB), 18 decimals, no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints the fixed 1,000,000,000-token supply once to its deployer; it exposes no owner, further mint, burn, tax or pause. CurbHook is src/CurbHook.sol, using the vendored OpenZeppelin uniswap-hooks BaseHook. Constructor arguments follow the declaration: poolManager_, token_, initializer_, owner_, bandTicks, edgeTicks, refWindow, limitSeconds, haltSeconds, cooldownSeconds, minLiquidityE18, arbBlocks. The seven numeric settings are 1000, 100, 300, 15, 900, 1800 and 100000; durations are seconds and minLiquidityE18 scales to 1e23 in-range liquidity. arbBlocks is true. Deploy with CREATE2 mining for flags 0x20C0, exactly beforeInitialize, beforeSwap and afterSwap. BaseHook restricts all callbacks to the PoolManager. Initialization is allowed once, only with sender $factory, a key containing $token, static fee 12500 and tick spacing 60. This manifest selects CURB/IMD on Robinhood Chain. The hook takes no additional fee, returns zero deltas and enables no liquidity or donation callbacks; adding, removing and the factory's zero-liquidity fee collect are untouched. The pool charges the specified 1.25% LP fee. Outside a halt, the band check rejects a swap ending more than 1000 ticks from the time-weighted reference and farther from it than the starting tick; moves toward the reference pass that check. The 300-second reference window rolls lazily on swaps, with clamping to keep the current tick out of the edge zone. Remaining in the 100-tick edge zone for 15 seconds triggers a halt in both directions for at most 900 seconds, followed by a 1800-second cooldown measured from the scheduled halt end. When in-range liquidity is below the floor, the hook does not start the edge clock or roll the reference. A swap starting below that floor may be admitted within 1000 ticks of the first qualifying liquidity boundary it crosses, reanchoring the reference. The immutable owner is $owner, the CurbDesk contract paying for this launch. Its sole hook authority, resolve(nonce, verdict), may end an active halt early or pin the pre-move reference through cooldown, with clamping on reopen; it cannot extend a halt, change parameters, transfer ownership or move funds. Trade events and totalVolume record paired-currency volume; ArbSys supplies L2 block numbers with a bounded call and block.number fallback. pool.initialPrice is the required one-to-one sqrtPriceX96; deployment derives the actual opening price from the separate launch policy and token ordering. docs/VERIFICATION.md records a Robinhood fork rehearsal of LaunchFactory.launch with this token, hook and constructor settings in both token orders, including swaps, band refusal, fee collection, halt and oracle verdict delivery. Local offline checks passed: forge build; forge test (188 passed, 0 failed, 2 fork tests skipped without RH_RPC); script/protected.sh (13 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in each token order).
